questions.topic: Craft and Structure · Words in Context
questions.passage:
The success of the 606 Trail in Chicago, Illinois—an elevated park and trail showcasing various 
community public art projects—exemplifies how collaborative art initiatives can ______ their 
communities in multiple ways, including enhancing public spaces and revitalizing 
neighborhoods.
questions.prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
questions.options_raw:
A. enrich
B. predict
C. deny
D. avoid
questions.tier1_hint: 💡 Định hướng tư duy & Bối cảnh: Ngữ cảnh (Context) '...collaborative art initiatives can ______ their communities...'. Đọc kỹ ngữ cảnh để xác định chính xác mục tiêu và mối quan hệ ngữ nghĩa cốt lõi.
questions.tier2_hint: 🔍 Manh mối cấu trúc & Phân tích loại trừ: Manh mối chính: Manh mối (Clues) | 'enhancing public spaces' (nâng cấp không gian công cộng) | 'revitalizing neighborhoods' (hồi sinh khu dân cư). Hãy tự vấn: Phương án nào làm đảo lộn logic, lạc đề hoặc vi phạm cấu trúc ngữ pháp cần thiết?
questions.tier3_hint: 🎯 Chốt phương pháp & Đáp án: Từ cần điền phải mang sắc thái TÍCH CỰC và đồng nghĩa với việc 'làm cho tốt đẹp hơn' Lựa chọn chính xác duy nhất là [A].
questions.strategic_tip: Mẹo Princeton Review: Che các phương án lại, tự nghĩ ra 1 từ tiếng Anh đơn giản (Guess) rồi tìm phương án gần nghĩa nhất với từ đó.

questions.target_clue: Manh mối ngữ cảnh nằm ở cụm từ mô tả hành động và đặc tính chủ thể trong câu trích.
questions.solution_steps:
1. Xác định ngữ cảnh: Đoạn văn mô tả tính chất hoặc hành động đòi hỏi sắc thái từ vựng phù hợp.
2. Loại trừ: Các phương án gây nhiễu mang nghĩa lệch sắc thái hoặc sai phạm trù kết hợp từ.
3. Kết luận: Lựa chọn A ('enrich') diễn đạt chính xác nhất logic của câu.
questions.pro_tip: Từ vựng trong Digital SAT ưu tiên độ chuẩn xác theo văn cảnh học thuật (Contextual Precision) hơn là nghĩa phức tạp đơn lẻ.
questions.pooe_breakdown:
• Đáp án ĐÚNG: [A] — enrich (làm phong phú, làm cho tốt đẹp hơn): Hành động này có đồng điệu với ý nghĩa của từ "enhancing" (nâng cấp) và "revitalizing" (đổi mới) được nhắc đến ở cuối câu không?
• Loại [B] — predict (dự đoán): Một dự án nghệ thuật cộng đồng có thể thực hiện hành động "dự đoán" đối với chính cộng đồng của nó không? Câu "dự đoán cộng đồng bằng cách nâng cấp không gian" có hợp lý về logic không?
• Loại [C] — deny (phủ nhận, chối bỏ): Trong một câu đang ca ngợi "thành công" (The success), việc điền một động từ mang nghĩa tiêu cực (chối bỏ) có làm câu bị mâu thuẫn không?
• Loại [D] — avoid (tránh né): Nếu các dự án nghệ thuật "tránh né" cộng đồng, liệu chúng có thể tạo ra những tác động trực tiếp như "cải thiện không gian" cho chính cộng đồng đó được không?

option_explanations.A: ✅ ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG. enrich (làm phong phú, làm cho tốt đẹp hơn): Hành động này có đồng điệu với ý nghĩa của từ "enhancing" (nâng cấp) và "revitalizing" (đổi mới) được nhắc đến ở cuối câu không?

option_explanations.C: ❌ TẠI SAO SAI. deny (phủ nhận, chối bỏ): Trong một câu đang ca ngợi "thành công" (The success), việc điền một động từ mang nghĩa tiêu cực (chối bỏ) có làm câu bị mâu thuẫn không?

Commercial truck drivers sometimes transport temperature-sensitive goods like fresh produce 
through a variety of external conditions that can affect temperatures inside cargo areas, ______ 
the use of specialized equipment to continuously and automatically monitor and adjust 
refrigeration settings to prevent the goods from spoiling.
questions.prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
questions.options_raw:
A. rescinding
B. extolling
C. obviating
D. necessitating
questions.tier1_hint: 💡 Định hướng tư duy & Bối cảnh: Nguyên nhân (Vấn đề) Thời tiết bên ngoài ảnh hưởng nhiệt độ thùng hàng đe dọa làm hỏng hàng hóa nhạy cảm. Đọc kỹ ngữ cảnh để xác định chính xác mục tiêu và mối quan hệ ngữ nghĩa cốt lõi.
questions.tier2_hint: 🔍 Manh mối cấu trúc & Phân tích loại trừ: Manh mối chính: Kết quả (Giải pháp) Sử dụng thiết bị chuyên dụng để tránh hỏng hàng | Manh mối logic: Nguy cơ hỏng hàng hóa khiến giải pháp bảo vệ trở thành một điều KIÊN QUYẾT PHẢI CÓ. ➔ Từ cần điền mang nghĩa 'Đòi hỏi / Bắt buộc'.. figuring out system configurations instead of remedying the situation.

Text 1 
 
The poet Audre Lorde once claimed that poetry is the most inexpensive of art forms to practice. 
While people who pursue other art forms—sculpture, film, theater—require large blocks of 
uninterrupted time as well as money to complete their work, poets can write, as Lorde said, 
"between shifts, in the hospital pantry, on the subway, and on scraps of surplus paper." So poets 
can make worthwhile art even if they must earn their living in another way. 
 
Text 2 
 
Any assessment of the state of contemporary poetry must reckon with the professionalization of 
the field. While it is possible in theory for anyone to publish in Virginia Quarterly Review,
questions.prompt:
Harvard Review, or a similar major poetry outlet, many people who do so have professional 
training in poetry and extensive practice writing it, which requires time not often available to 
those who must also work full-time jobs. Thus, financial security indirectly affects which people 
become poets. 
Based on the texts, how would Lorde (Text 1) most likely respond to the argument presented in 
Text 2?

Through the Urban Wildlife Information Network, citizen scientists systematically document 
animals they observe in metropolitan areas. Participants record not just which species they see 
but also the species' behaviors and nearby urban features, such as artificial lighting, buildings, 
and green spaces. The resulting database helps researchers understand how animals adapt to 
human-dominated landscapes and informs city planning and conservation efforts that benefit 
both people and wildlife.

Wildlife Information Network?

It informs city planning and conservation efforts.
It ranks the popularity of green spaces with city residents.
It inspires tourists to visit metropolitan areas.

The following text is adapted from the 1940 novel The Hamlet by William Faulkner. In rural 
Mississippi, a man referred to as the stranger is walking among a group of untamed calico 
(spotted) horses that he has penned in a lot. 
 
[The horses] whipped and whirled about the lot like dizzy fish in a bowl. It had seemed like a big 
lot until now, but now the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside 
any one fence was something to be repudiated with contempt, like a mirror trick. From the 
ultimate dust the stranger, carrying the wire-cutters and his vest completely gone now, 
emerged. He was not running, he merely moved with a light-poised and watchful celerity, 
weaving among the calico rushes of the animals, feinting and dodging like a boxer until he 
reached the gate and crossed the yard. 
 
©1967 by Estelle Faulkner and Jill Faulkner Summers 
Which statement about the stranger is best supported by the text?

options.text: He remains composed even while navigating the potentially dangerous situation in the  pen.
The manner in which he crosses the pen is intended to calm the horses but has the  opposite effect.
He is prepared to escape the pen immediately if the horses begin to approach him.
His self-assured demeanor falters when subjected to the chaos in the pen.

questions.prompt:
Some climate models predict that the habitat ranges of North American trees will expand 
northward as average temperatures warm. However, some tree species, like sand post oaks and 
limber pines, haven't expanded. This is called "migration lag"—when species fail to expand their 
range, even when conditions seem right. Scientists have proposed several possible explanations: 
fewer species of soil fungi available at the northern edges of the trees' habitat, physical barriers 
blocking seed dispersal, or deer overgrazing preventing new trees from establishing. 
According to the text, what unexpected phenomenon are scientists observing with North 
American tree species?

options.text: The ranges of sand post oaks and limber pines are primarily expanding southward  instead of northward.
Some North American tree species aren't increasing their habitat ranges despite suitable  climate conditions.
The ranges of sand post oaks and limber pines are expanding more rapidly than climate  models predicted.
Some North American tree species are developing resistance to fungal partnerships at  the northern boundaries of their ranges.

questions.options_raw:
A. The ranges of sand post oaks and limber pines are primarily expanding southward  instead of northward.
B. Some North American tree species aren't increasing their habitat ranges despite suitable  climate conditions.

Average Total Agricultural Export Growth Rate, Five Years Pre- and Post-FTA with the United 
States 
 
| Export growth | Pre-FTA | Post-FTA | 
|---|---|---| 
| Guatemala (CAFTA-DR) | 13.8% | 20.1% | 
| Mexico (NAFTA) | -1.5% | 13.6% | 
| Morocco (MAFTA) | 19.6% | 4.9% | 
 
To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs)—agreements among nations to 
reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers—experience changes in total agricultural exports, 
economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several 
countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United 
States. The graph shows the results for three countries in the study. Consulting the graph, a 
student claims that joining an FTA increases the rate of growth of a country's total agricultural 
exports.
questions.prompt: Which choice best describes data from the graph that weaken the student's claim?

options.text: All the countries shown had positive growth in agricultural exports over the five years  after joining their respective FTAs, but their rates of export growth varied.
Although agricultural exports from Morocco grew over the five years after Morocco  joined MAFTA, their growth rate was even higher in the five years before MAFTA.
Although agricultural exports from Mexico decreased over the five years before NAFTA, a  reversal in this trend was observed over the five years after Mexico joined NAFTA.

Over the five years after Guatemala joined CAFTA-DR, agricultural exports from  Guatemala grew at a rate of about 20.1 percent, which is higher than the rate over the five  years before Guatemala joined the agreement.

questions.options_raw:
A. All the countries shown had positive growth in agricultural exports over the five years  after joining their respective FTAs, but their rates of export growth varied.
B. Although agricultural exports from Morocco grew over the five years after Morocco  joined MAFTA, their growth rate was even higher in the five years before MAFTA.
C. Although agricultural exports from Mexico decreased over the five years before NAFTA, a  reversal in this trend was observed over the five years after Mexico joined NAFTA.
D. Over the five years after Guatemala joined CAFTA-DR, agricultural exports from  Guatemala grew at a rate of about 20.1 percent, which is higher than the rate over the five  years before Guatemala joined the agreement.

Jansson resigned from creating a daily Moomin comic strip in 1959 after working on it  for seven years, and her brother Lars took her place.

organic food options more appealing to customers than nonorganic foods, including placement

store promotional messaging have been found to be effective only for certain categories of
questions.prompt:

gathering information about localized customer preferences to deploy sales tactics for  organic foods more strategically at each store.
ensuring that organic products are clearly distinguished from nonorganic products in  terms of messaging, placement, and price.
combining in-store promotional messaging with social media messaging to ensure  customers are aware of certain features of organic products.

For thousands of years, O’odham farmers in the Sonoran desert of the southwestern US and 
northern Mexico have cultivated mesquite seeds and agave sap, sometimes planting these 
species together so that the mesquite trees provide shade for agaves. Doing so helps protect 
agaves from the harshest heat and light and thereby helps prevent soil moisture from 
evaporating. 
 
Text 2 
 
Agaves are well adapted to growing in the desert but grow best when shaded. Inspired by 
O’odham farmers, who often strategically plant agaves in the shade of sun-hardy species like 
mesquite trees for protection from the sun and heat, Gary Nabhan and colleagues planted 
agaves in the shade of solar panels in the Sonoran desert and found that the plants grew well, 
suggesting to Nabhan and colleagues that the panels provide a benefit similar to that provided 
by mesquite trees.

“Oh, how my heart jumped when I heard a noise close by. It was a horse running  towards us. We had to lie down close to the ground. It came close to us and stopped. Oh,  how my heart beat! I thought whoever it was would hear my heart beat.”

“Late in that fall, there came news that my grandfather was on his way home. Then my  father took a great many of his men and went to meet his father, and there came back a  runner, saying, that all our people must come together.”
“So ended our feast, and every family went to its own home in the pine-nut mountains,  and remained there till the pine-nuts were ripe. They ripen about the last of June.”

The British Bronze Age began when sophisticated metalworking was introduced to the British 
Isles around 2500 BCE, and it lasted until around 700 BCE. Collections of Bronze Age metal items 
(called hoards) have been found all over Britain, and while most of the objects found in these
questions.prompt:

hoard included bronze weapons and jewelry, but a few included objects made of gold, such as 
the Whalley hoard, which contained bronze weapons and gold jewelry. As ancient metalsmiths 
in Britain gained knowledge from working metals like bronze, they were able to apply those 
skills to work other metals as well, but it’s not surprising that few hoards contained gold 
because ______ 
Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.text: gold was much rarer and more difficult to obtain than bronze.
not all jewelry from the Bronze Age was made of gold.
gold was more valued for its beauty than bronze was.
some hoards were found as a result of artifacts being dug up by accident.

questions.topic: Standard English Conventions · Form, Structure, and Sense
questions.passage:
When a seed is ready to sprout, its hard outer covering (called a seed coat) absorbs water and 
splits open. Then, a root begins to grow downward into the soil, and the first shoot starts 
______ upward.
questions.prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.options_raw:
A. had grown
B. to grow
C. has grown
D. grows
questions.tier1_hint: 💡 Định hướng tư duy & Bối cảnh: Nhận diện cấu trúc song hành (Parallel Structure) được nối bởi liên từ 'and': vế 1 là 'begins to grow downward', vế 2 là 'starts ______ upward'.
questions.tier2_hint: 🔍 Manh mối cấu trúc & Phân tích loại trừ: Động từ 'starts' ở hiện tại đơn cần kết hợp với dạng nguyên mẫu có 'to' (to grow). Loại các phương án chia thì hoàn thành hoặc chia thừa động từ (had grown, has grown, starts grows).
questions.tier3_hint: 🎯 Chốt phương pháp & Đáp án: Cấu trúc song hành hoàn chỉnh bắt buộc phải dùng [B] to grow.
questions.strategic_tip: Mẹo Grammar: Nếu 2 phương án cùng có chức năng ngắt 2 mệnh đề độc lập (ví dụ '.' và ';'), cả hai thường cùng sai!
questions.level1_tip: 💡 Định hướng tư duy & Bối cảnh: Nhận diện cấu trúc song hành (Parallel Structure) được nối bởi liên từ 'and': vế 1 là 'begins to grow downward', vế 2 là 'starts ______ upward'.
questions.level2_hint: 🔍 Manh mối cấu trúc & Phân tích loại trừ: Động từ 'starts' ở hiện tại đơn cần kết hợp với dạng nguyên mẫu có 'to' (to grow). Loại các phương án chia thì hoàn thành hoặc chia thừa động từ (had grown, has grown, starts grows).
questions.level3_solution: 🎯 Chốt phương pháp & Đáp án: Cấu trúc song hành hoàn chỉnh bắt buộc phải dùng [B] to grow.
questions.target_clue: Các thành phần nòng cốt của câu (S + V) và ranh giới giữa các mệnh đề.
questions.solution_steps:
1. Phân tích thành phần nòng cốt S-V.
2. Xác định vị trí ranh giới cần dấu câu hay dạng động từ thích hợp.
3. Chọn phương án [B] tuân thủ chuẩn Standard English Conventions.
questions.pro_tip: Chú ý dấu gạch ngang đôi (— ... —) hoặc cặp dấu phẩy bao quanh thành phần phụ chú; khi bỏ phần phụ chú đi câu nòng cốt vẫn phải hoàn chỉnh.
questions.pooe_breakdown:
• Đáp án ĐÚNG: [B] — to grow — Cấu trúc song hành hoàn hảo: 'begins to grow downward... and starts to grow upward'. Động từ 'starts' ở đây kết hợp với to-infinitive 'to grow' tương đồng với 'begins to grow' ở mệnh đề trước.
• Loại [A] — had grown — Chia thì quá khứ hoàn thành làm phá vỡ tính đồng nhất về thời gian với thì hiện tại đơn 'absorbs', 'splits', 'begins'.
• Loại [C] — has grown — Chia thì hiện tại hoàn thành, không tạo được cấu trúc song hành sau động từ 'starts'.
• Loại [D] — grows — Sau động từ đã chia 'starts', không thể đặt trực tiếp một động từ chia thì 'starts grows'. Bắt buộc phải là dạng nguyên mẫu có to.

option_explanations.A: ❌ TẠI SAO SAI. had grown — Chia thì quá khứ hoàn thành làm phá vỡ tính đồng nhất về thời gian với thì hiện tại đơn 'absorbs', 'splits', 'begins'.
option_explanations.B: ✅ ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG. to grow — Cấu trúc song hành hoàn hảo: 'begins to grow downward... and starts to grow upward'. Động từ 'starts' ở đây kết hợp với to-infinitive 'to grow' tương đồng với 'begins to grow' ở mệnh đề trước.
option_explanations.C: ❌ TẠI SAO SAI. has grown — Chia thì hiện tại hoàn thành, không tạo được cấu trúc song hành sau động từ 'starts'.
option_explanations.D: ❌ TẠI SAO SAI. grows — Sau động từ đã chia 'starts', không thể đặt trực tiếp một động từ chia thì 'starts grows'. Bắt buộc phải là dạng nguyên mẫu có to.

and the first shoot starts ______ upward.'"] --> B{"Phân tích vị trí điền khuyết"} B --> C["Vế 1: Động từ 'begins' đi kèm to-infinitive: 'to grow'"] B --> D["Vế 2: Động từ 'starts' cũng cần dạng tương ứng: 'to grow'"] C & D -.-> E["Quy tắc song hành & Cụm động từ:

questions.pooe_breakdown:
• Đáp án ĐÚNG: [B] — attract — Động từ chính (finite verb) chia thì hiện tại đơn số nhiều, tương ứng hoàn hảo với chủ ngữ số nhiều 'Nonmetallic elements' và trợ động từ 'do' ở vế đối chiếu.

Trade with other societies was vital to the Parthian Empire, which reigned in Mesopotamia from 
around 247 BCE to 224 CE. Its people profited by selling textiles, spices, and iron, items that 
______ greatly in demand.
questions.prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.options_raw:
A. was
B. is
C. were
D. has been
questions.tier1_hint: 💡 Định hướng tư duy & Bối cảnh: Đại từ quan hệ 'that' thay thế trực tiếp cho danh từ 'items' (số nhiều). Toàn bộ câu đang kể về Đế chế Parthia thời cổ đại (thì quá khứ).
questions.tier2_hint: 🔍 Manh mối cấu trúc & Phân tích loại trừ: 'items' là danh từ số nhiều nên to-be phải ở dạng số nhiều. Bối cảnh quá khứ loại các thì hiện tại (is, has been). 'was' là số ít nên bị loại.
questions.tier3_hint: 🎯 Chốt phương pháp & Đáp án: To-be ở quá khứ số nhiều phù hợp duy nhất là [C] were.

questions.pooe_breakdown:
• Đáp án ĐÚNG: [C] — were — Đại từ 'that' bổ nghĩa cho danh từ số nhiều 'items'. Trong bối cảnh lịch sử quá khứ (profited, reigned), to-be bắt buộc phải chia ở dạng quá khứ số nhiều 'were'.

questions.prompt:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: 
 
A merchant vessel is any ship hired to carry cargo or passengers. 
 
Common merchant vessels include bulk carriers, cruise liners, and oil tankers. 
 
A vessel’s carrying capacity is also known as its deadweight tonnage (DWT). 
 
In 2021, there were a total of 1,051 merchant vessels registered in Cyprus. 
 
The combined DWT of these vessels was 34 million tons. 
The student wants to explain what a merchant vessel is and provide examples. Which choice 
most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: In total, Cyprus’s 1,051 merchant vessels had a carrying capacity of 34 million tons in  2021.
A merchant vessel is any ship hired to carry cargo or passengers—like bulk carriers,  cruise liners, and oil tankers.
There were a total of 1,051 ships hired to carry cargo or passengers registered in Cyprus  in 2021.
The carrying capacity of bulk carriers, cruise liners, and oil tankers is measured in  deadweight tonnage.

questions.topic: Expression of Ideas · Rhetorical Synthesis
questions.prompt:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: 
 
The French Republican calendar was used in France from 1793 to 1805. 
 
Each calendar week had ten days, two of which were called quintidi and decadi. 
 
Each quintidi was given a unique name in honor of an animal. 
 
Each decadi was given a unique name in honor of an agricultural tool. 
 
Bœuf, a quintidi in the month of Vendémiaire, was named after the ox. 
 
Van, a decadi in the month of Nivôse, was named after the winnowing fan. 
The student wants to emphasize a difference between quintidi and decadi. Which choice most 
effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Each decadi was named after an agricultural tool; for example, a decadi during the  month of Nivôse was named after the winnowing fan.
There were ten days in each week of the French Republican calendar, and two of these  days were called quintidi and decadi.
One quintidi during the month of Vendémiaire was named after an animal, the ox.
Each quintidi in the calendar honored an animal, such as the ox, whereas each decadi  honored an agricultural tool, such as the winnowing fan.

questions.options_raw:
A. Each decadi was named after an agricultural tool; for example, a decadi during the  month of Nivôse was named after the winnowing fan.
B. There were ten days in each week of the French Republican calendar, and two of these  days were called quintidi and decadi.
C. One quintidi during the month of Vendémiaire was named after an animal, the ox.
D. Each quintidi in the calendar honored an animal, such as the ox, whereas each decadi  honored an agricultural tool, such as the winnowing fan.

questions.tier2_hint: 🔍 Manh mối cấu trúc & Phân tích loại trừ: Trong Notes, quintidi được đặt theo tên động vật (animal - con bò bœuf), còn decadi được đặt theo tên nông cụ (agricultural tool - cái nia van). Câu đúng phải so sánh đối chiếu trực tiếp cả 2 đối tượng bằng từ nối tương phản 'whereas'.

strategies.core_rules:
• Total 54 Questions (27 per module), 64 minutes total.
• Domains: Information & Ideas (26%), Craft & Structure (28%), Expression of Ideas (20%), Standard English Conventions (26%).
• Adaptive Format: Module 2 difficulty adapts based on Module 1 performance.
strategies.traps:
• Detail Traps: Options true in reality but not supported by passage.
• Half-Right Traps: First half correct, second half flawed.
• Extreme Words: Words like 'always', 'never', 'completely'.

strategies.core_rules:
• Total 44 Questions (22 per module), 70 minutes total.
• Domains: Algebra (35%), Advanced Math (35%), Problem-Solving & Data Analysis (15%), Geometry & Trig (15%).
• Desmos Graphing Calculator permitted for ALL math questions.
strategies.traps:
• Unit Conversion Traps: Forgetting to convert minutes to hours or cm to m.
• Question Prompt Traps: Solving for x when asked for x + y or 2x.
• Extraneous Solutions: Forgetting to check roots in radical/rational equations.

strategies.core_rules:
• Use Continuers (+/+), Contradictors (+/-), or Cause/Effect clues.
• Predict a simple word before looking at choices.
• Watch for secondary academic meanings of common words (e.g., 'register', 'compromise').
strategies.traps: • Choosing common definitions instead of context-specific academic meanings.

strategies.core_rules:
• Textual Evidence: Match exact claim with specific line or quotation.
• Quantitative Evidence: Read graph/chart axes and key carefully before evaluating choices.
strategies.traps: • Selecting options that are true according to the graph but irrelevant to the thesis.

strategies.core_rules:
• Semicolon = Period = Comma + FANBOYS (nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập).
• Colon (:) used after complete sentence to introduce list, explanation, or quote.
• Match Subject-Verb agreement by striking out intervening prepositional phrases.
strategies.traps: • Comma Splices: Nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập chỉ bằng dấu phẩy.

strategies.core_rules:
• Parallel lines = No solution (m1 = m2, b1 != b2).
• Same line = Infinitely many solutions (m1 = m2, b1 = b2).
• Look for opportunities to add/subtract equations to find target expressions directly.
strategies.traps: • Solving for individual variables when the prompt asks for an expression like x + y.

strategies.core_rules:
• Vertex form y = a(x - h)^2 + k -> Vertex at (h, k), max/min = k.
• Vieta's Formulas: Sum of roots = -b/a, Product of roots = c/a.
• Remainder Theorem: Remainder of P(x) / (x - c) is P(c).
strategies.traps: • Sign errors when identifying vertex coordinates from equation.
